Mystery Sheen, Offshore LA

2012-04-11
On 11APR12 USCG contacted NOAA about a mystery sheen about 50nm offshore, south of the Mississippi River Delta. The report came from a good Samaritan overflight. The sheen is 15 mi by 50 yrd and silvery. Unknown product, unknown source, unknown quantity. The USCG has requested a trajectory and weather forecast.
